<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M⁺ 224.1201, matching C₁₆H₁₆O) and the ¹H NMR data (a 3 H singlet for a para‑methyl, two 2 H triplets for a –CH₂–CH₂– chain, and 9 aromatic protons), the structure that fits is a benzophenone derivative where one phenyl ring bears a para‑methyl and the carbonyl carbon is attached to a –CH₂–CH₂– linker to the second phenyl ring. The SMILES that encodes this structure is O=C(c1ccccc1)CCc2ccc(C)cc2.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)CCc2ccc(C)cc2</final_answer>
